rv.q: Gunderson's voice has never failed her; her lines and plot structures are not only realistic and appropriate, but they are often perfect.
Together with all the artists involved, they have conjured a real holiday treat at Northlight with simple tools—the English language, artistic excellence and storytelling par excellence.
'All The World' is a must-see, delightful holiday treat!
The two actors, with Thebus' savvy direction, create the sizzle that makes All the World work so well.

That is pretty much where the title of Lauren M. Gunderson's play, "All The World", now having its World Premiere at Northlight Theatre in Evanston, takes us. This is a love story that deals with two actors, who find themselves working together in a repertory theater.
